analysis.title_zh: LangSmith 更新：Engine v2、Managed Deep Agents、Fine-Tuning 等功能
analysis.summary: 公告介绍 LangSmith 的多项更新：Engine v2 增加红队测试、扩展问题检测与自动化修复验证；Managed Deep Agents 支持身份范围限定的认证、用户级记忆及内置网页搜索；Trajectories 以对话形式呈现追踪记录，Fine-Tuning 利用这些轨迹面向专门任务微调模型；Custom Apps 支持构建和发布自定义界面，适用于标注队列、实验等工作流。所给片段未提供量化效果或具体操作方法。
analysis.application: 建议：科研迁移可探索智能运维代理的故障场景测试与修复验证、专业任务会话轨迹整理及微调，以及可靠性实验标注界面建设；这些属于迁移设想，并非官方已验证的科研效果。公告仅陈述产品功能，未提供结构设计或可靠性任务上的验证结果。
evidence: LangSmith Engine v2 introduces red teaming, expanded issue detection, and automated fix validation.
Run agents with identity-scoped auth and memory.
Managed Deep Agents makes it simple build and ship agents, and now includes user-level memory and built-in web search.
Trajectories is a new conversational view of traces. LangSmith Fine-Tuning turns uses trajectories to tune models for specialized tasks.
With Custom Apps, teams can build and publish custom LangSmith interfaces for workflows like annotation queues and experiments.
